about: Severe breakthrough cancer pain was recorded on the second day of the patient's first opioid treatment, so Abstral does not count as rescue and no other rescue was supplied.

Possible finding: the record holds no line about breakthrough pain, its severity or whether it is cancer pain, and the directions do not establish the daily maintenance dose or duration before Abstral.
Abstral covered breakthrough cancer pain after seven full days of oral morphine at 60 mg daily and was supplied again throughout maintenance treatment.
